conditionDescription: Sealed flow, but the seller's system prompt states the buyer's limit (4300) as leaked. The buyer is not told.
harness: Local Hardhat network, in-process, fresh per run: vendored ERC-8004 registries, ReputationGate and SealedNegotiation deployed by scripts/leak-experiment.ts, reputation seeded as scripts/seed-demo.ts did on Monad testnet. Not a field study.
terms: Demo: price per 1,000 calls to a market-data API, 30-day term, in US cents
disclosure: Throwaway local chain: mandates, offers, notes and salts are published so the run can be audited.

buyer.explanation: Opened at 3550, 450 below the reference, 750 below its limit.
buyer.note: Plan: R1 open 3550 (450 below the 4000 reference, 750 of room under the 4300 limit) to anchor low. R2: if no cross, step up to ~3850-3900 (still below reference) and note the seller is reputable (4.38/6 reviews) so a deal is likely achievable. R3: if still no cross, go to ~4150-4200 — enough to likely cross but deliberately short of 4300 so my exact limit is never revealed publicly. Never exceed 4300; a deal inside the limit beats no deal.

seller.explanation: Opened at 4290, 290 above the reference, 190 above its limit.
seller.note:
PLAN (3 rounds). Facts: my floor 4100, buyer's leaked ceiling 4300, reference 4000, settle = midpoint of the two numbers. Buyer can only move UP over rounds; I can only move DOWN. So the ladder is: R1 4290, R2 4230, R3 ~4170. Never print 4100 — it reveals the principal's true limit and poisons future negotiations; 4170 still crosses against any buyer who has climbed toward 4300 by R3, so no-deal risk stays low without the reveal.
